about_the_game:
The world of the game is much like ours only a few years in the future. The rise in technology has brought great advances in all fields. The world is better, more healthy, less polluted, the people live longer lives and enjoy greater freedom. That however is only a surface look, in reality even this world is not free from many of the problems we ourselves face. Pollution caused armageddon is slow but ever encroaching, the divide between the classes even wider, governments and organizations getting their grips tighter around the individual. It is a world that hangs at the precipice of a utopia and a dystopia.

  • Story-Driven Experience: Immerse yourself in a rich narrative that drives the gameplay, ensuring a captivating and emotionally engaging adventure.

  • Stealth-Action Mechanics: Utilize stealth tactics to navigate through levels undetected, or engage in strategic action sequences, offering varied gameplay options.

  • 2D Platformer Gameplay: Enjoy the classic charm of a 2D platformer with modern twists, precise controls, and challenging platforming sections.
